summary: Complete testing of Standalone Tactical Board HTML page at /tactical-board.html. Backend: 12/13 tests passed (1 intermittent LLM parsing failure). Frontend: All 13 UI tests passed - page layout, category tabs, sport switching, drawing tools, player elements, dispositions, formations modal, AI modal, grid toggle, undo/redo, zoom controls.

minor.issue: Intermittent 500 error when LLM returns invalid JSON (basketball test failed once, passed on retry)

critical_code_review_comments: Standalone tactical-board.html is well-structured with all features in a single file (~960 lines)
8 sport categories with dropdown sport selection working correctly
15+ sport field SVGs defined (Futbol, Baloncesto, Voleibol, Tenis, Padel, Boxeo, MMA, Atletismo, Natacion, etc.)
8 drawing tools implemented (move, pencil, line, curve, arrow, zone, text, eraser)
7 player elements (Jugador A, Jugador B, Portero, Balon, Cono, Bandera, Valla)
6 spatial dispositions (Fila, Circulo, Grilla, Parejas, Rombo, Triangulo)
Predefined formations for Football (4-3-3, 4-4-2, 3-5-2, 4-2-3-1), Basketball (2-3 Zona, 1-2-2, 3-2), Volleyball (5-1, 4-2)
Drag & drop, selection, undo/redo, zoom/pan, export PNG all functional
AI generation modal opens and connects to backend API
context_for_next_testing_agent: Standalone Tactical Board at /tactical-board.html fully tested. Features verified: 1) Page loads with header, toolbar, canvas, panel, footer. 2) 8 category tabs (Conjunto, Raqueta, Contacto, Tiempo/Marca, Individuales, Orientacion, Esports, Gimnasio). 3) Sport dropdown shows sports per category. 4) Field SVG changes when sport selected (tested Futbol→Tenis). 5) Drawing tools work (playerA, cone, ball, arrow tested). 6) Properties panel shows element count. 7) Footer stats update with player counts. 8) Formations modal shows predefined formations. 9) Disposition modal allows placing athletes in patterns. 10) AI modal opens for generation. 11) Grid toggle works. 12) Undo/Redo functional. 13) Zoom controls (+/-/reset) work. Backend API /api/tactical-board/generate works but has intermittent LLM parsing issues.
